newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow in Kansas on Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Inquiry good, demand moderate, USDA said.

Sales confirmed on 4,000 slaughter steers and 4,400 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 77,000 head confirmed including 24,300 head or about 32 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1170-1300 lbs 65.00.
Dressed basis Select and Choice 1200-1250 lbs 105.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1175 lbs 65.00, few 64.00-64.50.
week to date: 77,000 last week: 74,700 last year: 13,600
